title: Morning evidence standup — SOC2 / vendors
content:
09:15 standup notes (quick, for my track)

Goals for today
- Close outstanding evidence gaps for quarterly SOC2 snapshot (keep this short).
- Push vendor questionnaire for 'VaultCloud' and confirm latest attestation doc.
- Get KMS rotation logs from infra and attach to evidence bucket.
- Draft short handoff for audit reviewer — one page summary.

Quick status
- User access review: fetched preliminary Okta CSV but still missing service-account group membership (see SEC-418). Need Diego to run query for sa-* groups.
- KMS/HSM evidence: last rotation entry missing (2026-03-30). Infra says rotation happened but logs not archived. Ticket raised (INF-2321). Follow up by EOD.
- Vendor VaultCloud: sales rep said they did a SOC2 Type II in Jan 2026 but haven't supplied the report. Email draft below.
- Baseline policies: data-retention policy update queued in Confluence; need to attach annotated diff for auditor.

TO-DO (today prioritization)
1) Vendor outreach (VaultCloud) — send terse email, request report + scope + AOC by EOD 2026-04-22 (15m)
   - Draft: "Hi Ana — quick request: could you share your latest SOC2 Type II (or equivalent) and the scope/AOC for our records? We need to confirm crypto at rest and key-management scope. Thanks — Leah."
2) Okta CSV complete (30m) — ask Diego for sa-* membership export and service account owner mapping. Add to evidence/okta/2026-04
3) KMS logs (45m) — ping infra: INF-2321 update; ask for archival path and checksum. If not available, request manual attest and a timeline.
4) Evidence bucket hygiene (20m) — move new PDFs to drive:/shared_drives/company/misc/compliance/evidence/2026-Q2 and add metadata file (evidence-index-2026-Q2.csv)
5) Audit one-pager (60m) — write short summary of open items + compensating controls (for auditor review tomorrow).

Blockers / Risks
- Vendor not producing report in time -> need fallback: ask for bridge attestation email from their security lead + any public audit repo link.
- KMS archival gap may be a control deficiency. If infra cannot produce logs this week, prepare mitigation notes and a retro plan.

Vendor checklist (VaultCloud)
- [ ] Current SOC2 Type II (signed PDF)
- [ ] AOC / scope definition (does it include KMS/HSM?)
- [ ] Crypto at rest description + key custody model
- [ ] Subprocessor list + last 12 months changes
- [ ] Incident history (last 24 months) and timeline to patch CVEs if any
- Contact: Ana Ruiz (ana@vaultcloud.example) — call window 14:00 PT today? Slot tentative.

Evidence checklist (items I'm tracking across artifacts)
- Okta: user export (CSV), group membership export, last 3 months SSO logs
- GCP/AWS: KMS rotation logs, key metadata, access policies (IAM bindings)
- HSM: rotation attestations, vendor support ticket history
- Change control: PR numbers for production changes tied to key materials (link PRs in evidence-index)

Quick notes to attach for auditor (short bullets)
- On KMS gap: retro plan + mitigation = manual rotation + cron audit + upload of archived logs by 2026-04-27; will surface escalation if not met.
- On vendors: if we only get partial doc, annotate scope differences and place in evidence folder with "vendor-annotation-<date>.md"

Draft email to VaultCloud (copy for Maya)
Subject: Request for SOC2 / AOC — Redwood Inference
Body:
Hi Ana,

We are conducting an internal evidence review for SOC2 compliance. Could you please share your most recent SOC2 Type II report (or equivalent), the AOC/scope that confirms inclusion of key management services, and any attesting statements about encryption at rest and subprocessor list? If a signed report isn't available, a statement from your security lead summarizing the controls and a date for delivery would suffice.

Thanks,
Leah Park
Security & Compliance

Meeting notes / quick log
- 09:00 sync with Maya: confirmed audit reviewer prefers a one-page summary + attachments. She will read the draft by 16:00.
- 09:30 call with Diego: he can run Okta export and add owner mapping by lunchtime.

Follow-ups for this week (beyond today)
- Thu 2026-04-23: finalize evidence-index csv and attach permalinks (drive + jira + confluence).
- Fri 2026-04-24: rehearsal call with auditor — run through Q&A including KMS and vendor scope.
- By 2026-04-27: ensure KMS archival gap resolved or submit remediation plan to SOC reviewer.

Misc scratch notes (brain dump)
- Possible compensating control: weekly manual snapshot + signed attestation by infra lead while automated archiving is implemented.
- Make sure to redline vendor docs with scope differences; keep a short matrix: vendor vs control mapping.
- Link to reference: https://confluence.redwood.example.com/display/SEC/SOC2-Evidence-Inventory (put anchor to OKTA and KMS sections)

Open questions (answer before EOD)
- Does VaultCloud outsource KMS to a third-party HSM vendor? (if yes, need subproc name + report)
- Can infra provide a signed attestation if logs cannot be found? What is their SLA on archival retrieval?

End of morning notes.
- Leah
